name: ContextualWeb News
tagline: Search and retrieve current news articles via ContextualWeb Search API.
description: ContextualWeb News is a news-search API (part of ContextualWeb / Web Search API) that returns news articles matching a query, with metadata such as titles, URLs, sources, and publication times. Used for building news aggregators, monitoring topics, and enriching applications with current events.

auth.details: API key via RapidAPI headers X-RapidAPI-Key and X-RapidAPI-Host; signup on RapidAPI marketplace.

pricing.paid_plans: RapidAPI freemium tiers; exact limits not independently verified in this pass.

use_cases: search recent news articles by keyword
monitor brand or topic mentions in the news
fetch headlines for a news aggregator dashboard
enrich apps with current-event context for a query
